purpose: Teach: オピニオン/図解/読み込み/終電/賃料/昇給/良品/単品

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界紙、オピニオン記事、いい着眼点だね。
lines.en: That trade publication piece has a really sharp angle to it.
lines.style: Approving nod in the voice. Quick, warm pace. Leaning forward slightly with genuine interest. Light and collaborative—not evaluative, encouraging.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内資料、図解中心で、再構成します。
lines.en: I'll take the internal docs and restructure them around the charts. Make it visual.
lines.style: Capable and steady. Matter-of-fact confidence without arrogance. Slight forward momentum—already thinking through the work as he speaks.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 読み込みの時間、確保しよう。
lines.en: Let's make sure we carve out reading time for this one.
lines.style: Gentle instruction. Not commanding—collaborative framing with 'let's.' Thoughtful pace, as if she's anticipating what Kenji will need.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。終電帰りも、最近、減りました。
lines.en: Good news on that front, actually. We've been catching fewer last trains lately.
lines.style: Lighter tone—a small relief breaking through. Not self-congratulatory, just genuine progress to share. Slight warmth on 'good news.'

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: オフィスの賃料、契約更新が近い。
lines.en: The office lease is coming up for renewal soon. We need to think about that.
lines.style: Businesslike but not cold. A practical concern settling in. Quiet deliberateness—she's weighing options even as she speaks.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。昇給制度、若手も対象に拡大します。
lines.en: Actually, we're expanding the raise structure to include the junior staff too. Should help.
lines.style: Genuine warmth breaking through. A decision he's proud of. Steady confidence—not boastful, just solid about doing right by the team.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 良品の検査、抜き打ちで実施しよう。
lines.en: Let's do random spot-checks on product quality. Keep them on their toes.
lines.style: Decisive but not harsh. A light edge of strategy underneath. Brisk delivery—she's thinking two steps ahead.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。単品ごとに利益率、分析中です。
lines.en: Right. I've been running the profit margins by individual item. Should have the breakdown soon.
lines.style: Focused and thorough. Almost thinking aloud—already deep in the numbers. Steady, reliable pace. The tone of someone who doesn't cut corners.
